messages.subject: stacked bar plot
parts:
I would like to make a stacked bar plot. I haven't been able to find
an example that works with the format of data I have.

The data is basically a matrix of proportions: https://gist.github.com/1074934

I would like to plot a stacked bar chart like the one in this image:

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/graphics/9ec03446056c3bb1d89ecc34eac0ddbb.png

With a bar for each center [Colorado, Germany, ...], and color by
Phylum [Bacteroidetes, Firmictues, ...], size of stacked bar chart by
proportion (the x, y value).

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: stacked bar plot
parts:
hi, here is an example:

head(d)
d2 <- melt(d, id="center")
ggplot(d2, aes(variable, value, fill=center)) + geom_bar()

ggplot2 can work well with *long* format of data, so you need to
convert your *wide* data into *long* data using melt().
